lead: Suvendu Adhikari is an Indian politician, born on 15 December 1970 in Contai.
As of 2026, he is 55 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has held the office of Member of the 15th Lok Sabha and Member of the 16th Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Suvendu facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Suvendu Adhikari — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Suvendu Adhikari was born on 15 December 1970 in Contai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Sisir Adhikari. He is a sibling of Dibyendu Adhikari and Soumendu Adhikari.
He received his education at Rabindra Bharati University.

sections.heading: Suvendu Adhikari — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 15th Lok Sabha (2009–2014), Member of the 16th Lok Sabha (2014–2016), Member of the 17th West Bengal Legislative Assembly and Chief Minister of West Bengal (2026–present). He is affiliated with All India Trinamool Congress.
